pretraining: DINOv3 LVD1689M general web images, then COCO object detection; use complete official detector weights

training.augmentation_schedule: Constant across these five recipe epochs; no negative stop epoch
training.terminal_checkpoint_selection: Best full-valid native1280 canonicalAP; patience2 with min_delta.003; minimum6totalepochs
training.continuation_schedule: Preserve saved optimizer base_lr and continue previous cosine; elapsed 6+1024/2250 passes of original13-pass continuation. Restart shuffled full image pass with actual extra exposure recorded.
training.host_memory_policy: USE_TF=0, USE_FLAX=0, workers0; record host RAM; model numerical recipe unchanged

evaluation.primary_postprocess: Native DETR top300, confidence.001, no NMS
evaluation.secondary_postprocess: Same fixed class NMS.70 for every arm/view on CPU after download
evaluation.cal_audit: Choose processed/original view on previously reused cal350 before scoring audit350; not independent holdouts
evaluation.CLAHE_practical_gate: >=.003 full and reused audit improvement over matched A on original valid, and small_AP loss <=.001
evaluation.Kaggle_gate: Also exceed matched Gentle1280 original-valid AP by >=.01 on full and reused audit before any test stage
evaluation.downstream: Assess DEIM adoption; develop five frozen candidates using valid only, then submit

recovery_policy.reason: One monitor timeout previously aborted a live worker; now reconnect transient requests and follow artifact state independently of websocket lifetime

partial_resume_policy: Preserve model/EMA/AdamW and actual counters; validate recovered partial model, then begin a new shuffled full pass. Do not claim exact remaining-image replay. Extra partial exposure remains in counters and is excluded from completed-whole-epoch count.
